product.name: Risk & Crisis Management
product.description: Service focused on identifying, assessing, and managing risks and crises to minimize impact on organizations.

product.name: Executive Logistics
product.description: Service providing organized and secure logistical support for executives during operations and travel.

product.name: Executive Protection
product.description: Close protection service designed to safeguard executives, celebrities, and high-net-worth individuals from physical threats.

product.name: Training & Development
product.description: Provision of training programs aimed at building skills and capabilities in risk management and security.

product.name: Rapid Deployment & Media Support
product.description: Service providing quick-response support and logistical assistance for media personnel in challenging environments.

product.name: Specialist Services
product.description: A range of tailored services addressing specific client needs in risk mitigation and security operations.
